topic: Day 8 — carousel — Every visible success has an invisible 3am you never see

slides.text: You're comparing your full picture to their highlight reel.
That comparison guarantees you lose. It's rigged by design.
The doubt never makes it into the photo.
You never see their [3am]. Just the morning after.

caption:
Every visible success has an invisible ledger of doubt running underneath it. You're comparing your full picture to someone else's curated one.

Follow for one of these a day.
